text: Chat agents run the Claude CLI with cwd=agents/<id>/ so Claude Code loads that CLAUDE.md natively and resolves @-imports each session; the BP path (agent-image/scripts/agent-entrypoint.py) instead reads CLAUDE.md raw and passes it via --system-prompt, which does NOT expand @-imports.

When 'gh-as-agent pr'/'push' fails with HTTP 409 (gh auth login / missing GH_TOKEN — an orchestrator-side outage), the branch is usually already pushed; open the PR with a direct 'gh pr create' after 'gh-as-agent stamp'-ing the body, since the agent's own gh token has repo scope. Only the orchestrator's token is broken, not the local one.
admin-console api test auth.test.js fails in this workspace with 'Cannot find module express-rate-limit' (deps not installed); it is a pre-existing environment issue, not a code regression.

gh-as-agent commit sets --author but git still needs a committer identity; if commit fails with 'Committer identity unknown', set a repo-local one (git -C <repo> config user.email/user.name to <agentId>@agents.local) — never --global.
A PR is not finished until the 'ready-for-review' label is set (that label triggers code review). Prior runs sometimes open the PR + comment but forget the label — check and add it.

GitHub-event triggers have no createdAt on any creation path (UI api.js, derived channel triggers in process-template.js expandGithubChannels), so the poller's history horizon (github-poller.js:343) falls back to triggers.json mtime; any routine rewrite of that file (one-shot consume, team re-derive, admin write-through via saveTriggers orchestrator.js:1213) bumps the mtime and silently drops recently-arrived events — root cause of intermittently-missed GitHub triggers (issues #320, #446, #525).
